_meta.purpose: The kind of each death, kept by hand (the human and Claude), read by tools/generation_report.py. Only deaths that are documented in docs/HANDOFF.md are classified here; the rest show up as 'not classified yet' on purpose.

kinds.bug: a loop or a defect: fix it
kinds.gap: a rule that was missing and the death repeated or was clearly avoidable: build the rule
kinds.decision: a choice a better agent could have made: it belongs in the agent's memory (ancestral wisdom), not in code
kinds.lab: a deliberate test run (a wished creature, a retry from a saved state): not a real death

_meta.fields: gen (the key), kind, cls (cause class, optional: overrides the one read from the chronicle), note (one line), issue (the HANDOFF issue that fixed or answered it, when there is one), urgent (true when the death shows a defect or gap that should be addressed immediately, before the next run; shown under NEEDS ATTENTION NOW until an issue is recorded)
_meta.history: Created 2026-10-12 (HANDOFF issue 172) after the human asked to learn from deaths: 'death of a character is a mechanic of roguelike games'.
